subject: Renewal paperwork choreography: term reshuffle + staged capacity uplift (MSA redlines)
messages:
From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@stellardata.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@stellardata.com
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + staged uplift — proposed term change and orderform updates

Hi Mateo / Jordan,

Thanks again for yesterday's call. StellarData is ready to move forward on a 24-month renewal but we'd like to shift to a 30-month term to align with our internal budgeting and stagger a capacity uplift across Q1 and Q2 of '27. High level asks: 
- Extend term to 30 months (effective at renewal start)
- Add a phased capacity uplift: +30% Jan '27, +20% Apr '27
- Review/accept limited indemnity language we flagged in the last MSA

Attached is our internal procurement worksheet. We need a clean redline of the MSA and an updated orderform by EOD Friday so our legal can run procurement by next Tuesday. Can you confirm who on your side will own the MSA redline and whether Redwood can accommodate a staged billing schedule?

Thanks,
Ari Kaplan
VP Procurement, StellarData
procurement@stellardata.com

Attachments: StellarData_Procurement_Worksheet.xlsx

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@stellardata.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + staged uplift — proposed term change and orderform updates

Ari — thanks for the clear asks. We can support a 30-month term and the two-step capacity uplift; billing can be staged but we need to align on invoice triggers and proration.

Plan on our side:
- I'll own overall coordination and will draft the orderform update (OrderForm_v3.xlsx).
- Laura (legal) will review and produce MSA redlines — looping Marissa for any commercial exceptions.
- Jordan will confirm SLA credit language changes for longer term.

Laura — can you take the MSA redline and focus on: the indemnity carve, data residency clause, and the proposed change to the termination for convenience notice period? We anticipate a few commercial asks from StellarData (credits for staged deliverables).

I'll push an initial orderform and a short playbook for sequencing by Wed. If we hit blockers on indemnity we may need a short exec escalation.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: OrderForm_v3_draft_note.txt

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + staged uplift — MSA redline intake

Mateo / Jordan — I pulled the current MSA and the edits Ari proposes. Quick notes: 
- Term extension is straightforward; we need to update the SLA measurement window language to reflect 30 months.
- Indemnity: StellarData wants to narrow Redwood's indemnity cap for third-party claims. Commercially we can agree to a carve for pre-existing IP claims limited to a fixed liability bucket, but we should resist a full carve that removes Redwood's right to defense.
- Termination for convenience: StellarData requests 60 days; our standard is 90. Given the longer term, I can accept 60 with a pro-rated termination fee for the remaining contract value (we'll quantify).

Marissa — please look at commercial/redline exposure (credits, proration and any SLA credit multipliers) and flag which items need VP approval. I'll produce a tracked Word redline by EOD today.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: StellarData_MSA_redline_annotated_notes.txt

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + staged uplift — commercial redline and proposed concessions

Team — read Laura's notes. My commercial view: we can grant the 60-day TF convenience with a pro-rata termination fee as a middle ground. On credits: StellarData asks for a one-time credit tied to the Jan '27 uplift (to offset migration costs). Recommend a fixed credit equal to 2% of the uplift tranche value (documented in orderform).

Proposed concessions summary (for VP sign-off):
- 30-month term (no price increase for term extension)
- Staged billing: Jan uplift billed on effective date of uplift, Apr uplift billed separately (proration handled by schedule)
- One-time uplift credit = 2% of Jan uplift tranche
- Limited indemnity carve: accept carve for legacy IP claims up to $250k, Redwood retains defense rights

Jordan — can you confirm whether this credit impacts any SLA credit pools or revenue recognition timing?

Marissa Cole
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Uplift_Credit_Model.xlsx

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + staged uplift — SLA & billing check

Marissa / Laura — quick confirm: the proposed one-time credit (2% Jan uplift) does not change SLA pools. It will be recorded as a contra-revenue credit applied against the invoice for the Jan uplift tranche; revenue recognition for the uplift follows our normal schedule once the uplift is effective. No change to SLA calculations.

I also updated the orderform to include explicit invoice triggers and pro-rate formula (see OrderForm_v3.xlsx). Suggest we ship MSA redline + orderform to StellarData with a short cover note and request a DocuSign execution by 8/26 to hit their procurement window.

Jordan Blake
Senior Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@stellardata.com>, Martin Reyes <m.reyes@stellardata.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 26 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal paperwork choreography: term reshuffle + staged capacity uplift (MSA redlines)

Ari / Martin — attaching the redlined MSA and updated orderform. Summary of what we can commit to: 
- 30-month term starting at renewal effective date (no price increase)
- Staged capacity uplift: +30% Jan '27, +20% Apr '27; billing and proration rules are in the orderform
- One-time uplift credit: 2% applied to the Jan uplift invoice
- Limited indemnity carve: Redwood will accept a carve for legacy IP claims up to $250k, Redwood retains defense obligations
- Termination for convenience: 60 days with pro-rated termination fee (calculation in orderform)

Next steps: 
1) Please review attached redline and orderform.
2) If acceptable, confirm and we'll send a DocuSign package (link included) by EOD Thursday so your procurement can route.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: StellarData_MSA_redline_20260816.docx; OrderForm_v3.xlsx; Uplift_Sequencing_Playbook.pdf
